scope: Primary-source follow-up of relevant leads from the bounded discovery queries. These dispositions concern replacement of the specified CX004 observations; they do not dismiss each study's own findings.

candidates.name: SRSF1 human fibroblast study
candidates.usable: 66 validation-library reference joins and 12 published 5-on/2-off reference rows across three donors. Existing 72 factor-off RNA libraries remain useful for bulk population comparisons.
candidates.remaining: Clock input preprocessing and intended correction path; per-library reference identities for recovery; short-induction timing conflict. Bulk means do not identify rare per-cell states or same-cell recovery.

candidates.name: Gill maturation-phase transient reprogramming
candidates.usable: Human fibroblast RNA and methylation after 4 or 5 weeks without doxycycline. The existing project reanalysis already supplies matched population-level identity/reprogramming panel contrasts.
candidates.remaining: Bulk, sorted/expanded populations do not provide the specified joint late per-cell measurements or calibrated rare-state burden. Induction-duration sample labels are not recovery harvest days.

candidates.name: Mesenchymal drift human time course
candidates.usable: Previously audited two-donor single-cell time course and linked bulk data.
candidates.remaining: The audited donor snapshots do not establish a controlled factor-off recovery sequence or biological safety labels; many cell barcodes do not create independent donors.

candidates.name: 2026 MSC Sendai-clearance study
candidates.usable: Public raw RNA runs and evidence of vector clearance in bulk populations and derived clones. First run accession and study relationship verified through ENA.
candidates.remaining: Umbilical-cord MSCs and hTERT/BMI1/SV40T intervention address different biology from adult lineage-preserving partial reprogramming. The study reports 25 RNA samples, while the stated deposited accession interval contains 24 runs; donor and sample reconciliation would precede any separate analysis. No raw-read download or novel outcome calculation is needed for the present target.

candidates.name: 2024 senescent endometrial MSC partial reprogramming
candidates.usable: Primary experimental report on cultured human MSC phenotypes.
candidates.remaining: A compatible deposited matrix with donor-linked age, identity and late per-cell recovery measurements was not identified in the inspected paper. This is a bounded source finding.

candidates.name: Early reprogramming intermediates for NGN2 neuronal conversion
candidates.usable: Uses an existing single-cell reprogramming dataset at days 0, 3, 5 and 11.
candidates.remaining: Directed neuronal conversion and induction-stage expression do not establish persistence of a rejuvenated original adult cell identity after factor withdrawal.

candidates.name: Interrupted reprogramming in human MSCs
candidates.usable: The GEO discovery record describes interrupted reprogramming and reports failure to rejuvenate human MSCs. This lead was also present in the October 17 census.
candidates.remaining: Its distinct cell system and bulk design do not supply the target joint per-cell recovery/ocular endpoint. No new outcome reanalysis was performed.
